statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I47.1, I49.5
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
